verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents how agents pay x402 and MPP endpoints and buy from any merchant given a product URL, but nothing shows a published directory or discovery index of payable services or APIs. The llms.txt file and the docs MCP search only help agents find Crossmint's own documentation, which is an adjacent feature, not service discovery. The axis is fair for an agent-payments platform, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can discover payable services and APIs through a published directory or discovery index
